subsetPolicyRationale: `s.norm.en1997@1` is this plugin's own self-contained Eurocode EN 1997 geotechnical-design document — there is no alternate conformance profile, encoding variant or standard subclass to split against: every mutation (change-v-ed-kn, change-h-ed-kn, change-footing-area-m2, change-phi-deg, change-c-kpa, change-gamma-kn-m3, …) reads and writes the SAME single value model this plugin owns, through the SAME codec/dispatch regardless of which field or entity it touches. `✳️any` remains this artifact's only real scope.
